When two or more computers are interconnected this is generally referred to as a network.
A LAN is a network in which all signals run on a single set of cables, which is fully administered by the owner.
Besides the cables linking the computers there are three components that are present in most networks.
All that means is that the device takes a series of electronic signals and converts them into pulses of sound, which can be sent along the telephone lines.
